goal: Define ORODI-ALERT-PROFILE as the reusable, platform-neutral contract for declaring evidence-only operational alerts before any renderer, runtime, notification, or deployment binding is selected.
goal_limits: the profile declares alert meaning and required evidence, not Grafana, Prometheus, or another platform provisioning format
alert evaluation is read-only and cannot deploy, roll back, promote, admit, accept, publish, release, or invoke a control-plane action
observed threshold breach, missing telemetry, and evaluation error retain distinct evidence meanings
missing telemetry and evaluation errors require fail-closed operator attention and can never be interpreted as healthy evidence
labels and dimensions are finite, declared, privacy-safe, and exclude secrets, request identifiers, timestamps, and arbitrary user values
notification delivery is absent unless a separately authorized Notification Delivery Binding exists
the Body War Grafana rule set is reference evidence only and does not define the reusable profile
original_intent: Extract the successful ORODI alerting pattern into a standard and reusable way to create alerts across ORODI contexts.

definition.normative_voice: A versioned, platform-neutral declaration of bounded telemetry sources, deterministic evidence-only alert rules, evidence-state semantics, finite labels, rendering obligations, and commissioning requirements for one ORODI context; it contains no operational action or notification destination.
definition.formal_voice: AlertProfile = (profile_id, profile_version, bounded_context, source_contracts, rule_set, state_model, label_contract, renderer_contract, commissioning_contract, authority_effect=none).
definition.plain_language_voice: It is the reusable recipe for what ORODI must watch and how failures must remain visible, before choosing a tool such as Grafana.
definition.domain_context_voice: In ORODI, projects instantiate this profile with their metrics and thresholds; the Body War rules are one reference instance, not the profile itself.
definition.boundary: Do not treat the profile as generated platform configuration, a notification route, a control policy, or authority to act.

definition.normative_voice: A declaration of one conserved telemetry source, its stable identity, query language, bounded dimensions, availability signal, and source-owned missing-data semantics used by alert rules.
definition.formal_voice: SourceContract = (source_id, source_kind, query_language, availability_projection, allowed_dimensions, conservation_obligations).
definition.plain_language_voice: It tells an alert where its evidence comes from and what counts as that evidence being unavailable.
definition.domain_context_voice: An ORODI source contract may bind to Prometheus and PromQL later, but it cannot manufacture absent series or healthy samples.
definition.boundary: Do not collapse a datasource connection, a generated query, or synthetic fallback data into source evidence.

definition.normative_voice: A language-tagged deterministic expression that derives one bounded alert input from an Alert Source Contract while preserving missing source telemetry and declared dimensions.
definition.formal_voice: MetricProjectionSpec = (source_id, expression_language, expression, lookback_window, result_shape, eligibility_guard?).
definition.plain_language_voice: It is the exact calculation the rule observes, together with enough context to interpret its result.
definition.domain_context_voice: A minimum-sample guard may prevent premature rate evaluation, but query-side zero synthesis cannot turn absent telemetry into normal evidence.
definition.boundary: Do not treat a projection as a new observation, causal proof, or permission to repair missing data.

definition.normative_voice: A stable rule identity combining one Metric Projection Specification, one deterministic comparison, explicit evaluation and persistence timing, fixed evidence labels, and explicit missing-data and evaluation-error attention policies.
definition.formal_voice: AlertRuleSpec = (rule_id, title, projection, predicate, evaluation_interval, persistence_duration, no_data_policy, error_policy, fixed_labels, annotations, severity, authority_effect=none).
definition.plain_language_voice: It states exactly what condition is watched, how long it must persist, and how missing or broken evaluation is surfaced.
definition.domain_context_voice: ORODI rules request operator attention only; they never call deployment, rollback, promotion, admission, or release endpoints.
definition.boundary: Do not embed platform provisioning syntax, credentials, arbitrary labels, or operational actions in the rule specification.

definition.normative_voice: The closed evidence-state set normal, pending, firing, no_data, and error, where every recorded transition retains its source outcome and observation time.
definition.formal_voice: EvidenceState = normal | pending | firing | no_data | error; no_data != error != firing and none of these values grants operational authority.
definition.plain_language_voice: The operator can tell the difference between healthy evidence, a developing breach, a confirmed breach, missing evidence, and a failed calculation.
definition.domain_context_voice: A platform may route no_data and error into fail-closed attention, but the ORODI evidence record must still preserve which state actually occurred.
definition.boundary: Do not flatten no_data or error into normal, or describe firing as proof of root cause.

definition.normative_voice: The invariant that an observed predicate breach, missing source telemetry, and an evaluation failure are distinct evidence conditions even when all require immediate operator attention.
definition.formal_voice: ObservedBreach, MissingTelemetry, and EvaluationFailure are pairwise distinct; AttentionRequired(x) does not imply Meaning(x)=ObservedBreach.
definition.plain_language_voice: Several problems can all deserve attention without pretending they are the same problem.
definition.domain_context_voice: ORODI renderers must preserve the source state in annotations or evidence even if a target platform uses one firing channel for all fail-closed conditions.
definition.boundary: Do not infer service degradation from missing telemetry, infer telemetry absence from evaluator failure, or coerce either condition into health.

definition.normative_voice: A finite declaration of allowed alert label keys and values whose Cartesian identity is bounded and excludes secrets, credentials, timestamps, request identifiers, and arbitrary user values.
definition.formal_voice: LabelContract = finite Map<LabelKey, finite Set<LabelValue>>; AlertInstanceIdentity = (rule_id, fixed_labels).
definition.plain_language_voice: Every label must come from a small known list so alert identities stay safe, stable, and understandable.
definition.domain_context_voice: ORODI commonly uses evidence-only authority, severity, and bounded scope labels; project dimensions must be declared before use.
definition.boundary: Do not use unbounded runtime values, personal data, request IDs, timestamps, tokens, or secrets as alert labels.

definition.normative_voice: One versioned, project-context instance of an ORODI Alert Profile containing unique stable rule identities and references only to declared source and label contracts.
definition.formal_voice: AlertRuleSet = (rule_set_id, profile_ref, context_ref, rules: NonEmptySet<AlertRuleSpec>), with unique rule_id and closed references.
definition.plain_language_voice: It is the actual collection of alerts one ORODI project wants, expressed without Grafana-specific YAML.
definition.domain_context_voice: The five Body War rules can later become one rule-set instance after a separately governed projection; they are not silently adopted here.
definition.boundary: Do not treat the rule set as rendered configuration, installed runtime state, or evidence that its rules work.

definition.normative_voice: A deterministic adapter that consumes one valid ORODI Alert Profile and Rule Set and emits target-platform alert configuration while preserving identities, predicates, timing, labels, state meanings, non-actuation, and notification separation.
definition.formal_voice: Render(platform_version, profile, rule_set) -> RenderedAlertArtifact, deterministic for exact input bytes and incapable of adding authority or destinations.
definition.plain_language_voice: It translates the reusable ORODI recipe into the configuration format understood by one alerting tool.
definition.domain_context_voice: A Grafana renderer may emit file-provisioning YAML, but Grafana-specific fields belong to the renderer binding rather than the business profile.
definition.boundary: Do not let a renderer invent rules, repair telemetry, add contact points, introduce credentials, or change alert meaning.

definition.normative_voice: A deterministic target-platform configuration postimage traceably derived from exact profile, rule-set, renderer, and platform-version inputs.
definition.formal_voice: RenderedAlertArtifact = (artifact_id, platform, platform_version, profile_digest, rule_set_digest, renderer_digest, content_digest, content).
definition.plain_language_voice: It is the generated Grafana or other platform file, with receipts showing exactly what produced it.
definition.domain_context_voice: The existing Body War Grafana YAML is reference evidence for a future renderer contract, not a generated artifact of this candidate profile.
definition.boundary: Do not call an artifact installed, accepted, conformant, or current merely because it renders deterministically.

definition.normative_voice: A bounded receipt set proving source availability handling, intended rule firing, recovery, terminal state, rule-set identity, rendered postimages, non-actuation, and notification-delivery absence for one exact commissioned context.
definition.formal_voice: CommissioningEvidence = (input_digests, rendered_digests, provisioned_rule_ids, firing_transitions, recovery_transitions, terminal_states, notification_attempt_count, non_actuation_checks).
definition.plain_language_voice: It shows that the exact alerts were installed for the test, fired when expected, recovered, and did not send or control anything.
definition.domain_context_voice: ORODI commissioning must include hostile missing-data and evaluator-error cases as well as an observed breach and recovery.
definition.boundary: Do not infer production readiness, causal diagnosis, notification delivery, or operational authority from commissioning evidence.

definition.normative_voice: A separately authorized external-effect binding that identifies allowed destinations, credentials, routing, redaction, retry, rate, and audit policy for transmitting alert states; it is absent from ORODI Alert Profile by default.
definition.formal_voice: NotificationDeliveryBinding = optional separately governed (destination, credential_ref, routing_policy, redaction_policy, retry_policy, rate_policy, audit_policy, authority_receipt).
definition.plain_language_voice: Evaluating an alert and sending it somewhere are separate decisions; the profile only defines evaluation.
definition.domain_context_voice: The Body War local inert sink demonstrates disabled delivery, not a reusable authorization for email, chat, paging, or webhooks.
definition.boundary: Do not infer a destination, reuse credentials, or enable delivery from profile adoption, rendering, validation, commissioning, or operator approval.

terminal_meanings.normal: observed evidence does not satisfy the alert predicate
terminal_meanings.firing: observed evidence satisfies the alert predicate for the required persistence duration
terminal_meanings.no_data: required source telemetry is absent or unavailable
terminal_meanings.error: the declared evaluation could not complete

separation_invariants: firing is not proof of causation
shared attention policy does not collapse evidence meaning

required_scenarios: observed recovery returns the rule from firing
missing telemetry is preserved as no_data and requests attention
evaluation failure is preserved as error and requests attention
all declared rules and only declared rules are provisioned
notification delivery attempts remain zero when no separate binding exists
no control-plane action is reachable from evaluation or rendered artifacts

evidence.claim: The current DomainSpec alert nodes expose rule identity, expression, evaluation interval, persistence duration, no-data behavior, error behavior, fixed labels, and evidence-state records as candidate modeled concepts.
The Body War binding and Grafana configuration provide one concrete reference realization with five fixed rules, fail-closed attention, non-actuation, and disabled external notification delivery.
The current implementation validator names Body War files and frozen rule identities directly, so it is evidence for a reference pattern rather than a generic profile compiler or validator.

Observed breach, no_data, and error remain distinct even when each maps to operator attention.
Notification delivery is absent by default and requires a separate binding and human authorization.
The pack grants no capability adoption, ontology admission, DomainSpec construction, implementation, notification, publication, release, or deployment authority.

Author or admit a Product Capability, business ontology, DomainSpec profile, compiled graph, system ontology, implementation binding, compiler, renderer, or runtime without the separately required D65 predecessor and owner decisions.

challenge_or_refresh_route: Return to DEFINE-SESSION-ORODI-ALERT-PROFILE-001 when alert meaning, state semantics, source contracts, label policy, renderer obligations, notification boundary, selected source bytes, or intended consumers change.

It defines the reusable alert-construction language and exposes the D65, portability, compiler, validation, and notification gaps. It does not adopt a Product Capability, admit an ontology or DomainSpec profile, create or accept an implementation binding, prove runtime conformance, enable notification delivery, publish, release, or deploy.
